criteria.details: 270 enabled, 131 aligned, 139 disabled (quality < 0.30 floor); 2 below floor. Q030 vs Q050: 0.993 vs 0.485. ADR-0034.

131/270 aligned (48.2%). Corpus geometry ceiling — out-and-back overlap pattern + limited cross-track redundancy at far end. Identical at Q030 and Q050 (corpus-blind). ADR-0035 falsified: threshold 0.50->0.30 does not recover registration.

Peak residual +/-1.76% of 250 mm = +/-4.4 mm across 3 bars (pairs 15-16, 19-20, 25-26). ADR-0031 floor 1 mm. Scale PASSED stage gate (inter-bar ratio 1.034 < 1.25; 3/3 validated). Residual attributed to underwater imaging geometry + no GCPs.

Initial auto-detection failed parity (suspect IDs 13, 24, 26). Human GUI correction applied; final: 6 markers detected (15, 16, 19, 20, 25, 26), all even-numbered, 3 consecutive pairs. PASS after correction.
All markers reprojection residual < 2.0 px ceiling. Projection counts: M15=15, M16=14, M19=9, M20=9, M25=7, M26=8.
93.7% < 95% threshold. Out-and-back trajectory means far end has lower coverage. Bypassed with --ignore-sanity (ADR-0033).
GATE#6 tests for single-pass belt geometry. EDR_T1_R2 is out-and-back (double-pass), which violates the single-pass test. Bypassed as a documented non-applicable gate (ADR-0033). Not a defect.

Physical-to-label correspondence for the far-end target (pair 25-26) unconfirmed pending Frank review. Positions are accurate (projection residuals < 2 px); a label swap between 25 and 26 does not affect the plane fit or scale. Open item: ADR-0033.

overall_assessment: Corpus geometry sets a firm registration ceiling (48.2% alignment rate); all other FAIL criteria are characterized and non-disqualifying. The reconstruction is the best achievable from this out-and-back imagery corpus.
